title: The King Is the Waiting Move
setup: The kings stand on e4 and h5, Black has a pawn one square from promotion on g2, and your queen guards g1.
hint: None of your pieces can afford to move. Look at the one you have not considered.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Kf5}} takes g4, g5 and g6 and hands Black the move. Only {{Kh4}} is legal, and {{Qh2#}} mates the king against the edge. A king step is a waiting move that also builds the net.
